admin.shell.deleteNowBody: Their account goes within 10 minutes instead of waiting out the 30 days. Only do this when they’ve asked you to.

admin.deleteHouse.body: Its Johns, weeks, Wall, history and Stake go for good. Everyone in it keeps their account, in no house. A House Pass it pays for stops renewing; any refund is yours to give in Stripe.
admin.deleteHouse.tell: Tell everyone in it, by push and email
admin.deleteHouse.confirm: Type the house’s name to delete it
admin.deleteHouse.gone: Gone for good, with everything in it. {people, plural, =1 {The 1 person} other {The {people} people}} in it keep their accounts{tell, select, true { and are told} other {}}; any House Pass stops renewing.

admin.deleteHouse.message: We’ve closed {name} on Jonz, so its Johns and history are gone. Your account is still here: start a new house or join one any time. Questions? Reply to this email.

admin.ask.title: Ask Jonz
admin.ask.label: Owner
admin.ask.greeting: Ask me about anything on the admin pages, or ask me to do it: reply to a report, put up a notice, send a message, make a promotion, start or stop a deletion. Anything I’d do goes on a card first, and happens when you tap.

admin.ask.offline: I can’t reach Claude just now, so I can’t answer. Everything I’d read is on the admin pages.
admin.ask.chatsNote: Only you can see these chats. They’re kept until you delete them.

admin.promotions.name: Name, for you
admin.promotions.amountHint: Other currencies get the same, at the Pass’s own prices.
admin.promotions.trialHint: Free before the first payment. They add a card, and can cancel before it ends.
admin.promotions.giftHint: No card. For good keeps the Pass on with no end date.

admin.promotions.maxUsesHint: Leave it empty for no limit.
admin.promotions.noteHint: They read it first, on the link and in the email: “Thanks for helping test Jonz.”
